verdict.rationale: Synctera's docs confirm it creates and manages customer accounts and supports internal transfers, which is consistent with account-provisioning capability for a BaaS platform, but there is no explicit evidence of issuing unique routing numbers, virtual accounts for reconciliation, per-customer collection accounts, or sub-account/master-account hierarchies. missing for 10: explicit routing-number issuance, virtual account/reconciliation feature docs, per-customer collection account docs, master/sub-account hierarchy docs.
